about: The Workbench icons of the Blupimania drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/blupimania.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a round yellow fellow reaching for a red balloon over a chequered floor) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/blupimania.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Blupimania-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Blupimania.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Blupimania.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, COPYING.txt, CREDITS.txt, LICENSE.all.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
